prediction.expect: A non-funerary opening (shaft, cistern or pit mouth, 1 m or wider) with at least one grave cut or tomb opening within 10 m of it.
prediction.where: The strip from the tell's north foot to about 250 m north: Kenyon II p. 169 skipped it; Area D lies about 100–200 m north (Fig. 91, inference). Under the ʿAin es-Sultan camp since 1948.
prediction.success: The opening and the grave appear in one registered record, and their distance is 'inside' 10 m under registration_protocol.md.
prediction.contradiction: Photographs and plans alone cannot contradict: absence may be concealment, burial or resolution. A contradiction needs a coverage-gated excavation record of the strip (coverage module gates) that reached the ancient surface and reports no such pair.
prediction.notes: Locating an opening does not date it. A success opens the next link (R-E60-PIT-PERIOD, R-E60-JOINT-ACCESS) on the same feature.
